help.title: PUGbot help
help.body: Join this channel's queue with `/add` and leave it with `/remove`. `/who` shows who is waiting. When the queue fills, the match starts automatically.
help.commands: Players: `/add` `/remove` `/who` `/promote` `/subscribe` `/server` `/maps` `/ready` `/teams` `/pick` `/subme` `/report` `/rank` `/leaderboard`. Staff commands live under `/queue`, `/match`, `/rating`, `/stats`, `/noadds` and `/channel`.
